fr.B: Je t’en prie, mon seigneur, ne fais pas attention à ce vaurien, à Nabal. Il est bien ce que dit son nom : il s’appelle Nabal, « Insensé », et la folie l’accompagne. Mais moi, ta servante, je n’ai pas vu les jeunes gens que mon seigneur avait envoyés.
fr.R: S’il te plaît, ne fais pas attention à Nabal. C’est un vaurien. Son nom veut dire « Insensé », et c’est bien un insensé ! Moi, je n’ai pas vu les jeunes gens que tu as envoyés, mon seigneur.

vi.L: Xin chúa tôi đừng để tâm đến người vô lại này, là Na-banh; vì tên người thế nào, người cũng thế ấy: tên người là Na-banh, và sự ngu dại ở với người. Còn tớ gái của chúa thì đã không thấy các thanh niên chúa tôi sai đến.
vi.B: Xin chúa tôi đừng để ý đến người vô lại ấy là Na-banh. Tên sao người vậy. Tên ông ấy là Na-banh, nghĩa là "Kẻ Ngu", và ông ấy thật là ngu dại. Còn đầy tớ của chúa tôi thì đã không thấy các thanh niên chúa tôi sai đến.
vi.R: Xin ông đừng để ý đến Na-banh. Ông ấy là người vô lại. Tên ông ấy có nghĩa là "Kẻ Ngu", và ông ấy đúng là ngu! Tôi đã không thấy các thanh niên ông sai đến.

decisions.choice: Nabal ... folly: his name and his character match
decisions.reason: Abigail plays on her husband's name: *naval* means a fool (verse 3), and *nevalah*, from the same root, is folly. It is not mere silliness but disgraceful conduct that breaks the bonds of decent life (Genesis 34:7; Judges 19:23; 2 Samuel 13:12).

decisions.choice: as his name is, so is he
decisions.reason: In Israel a name was often taken to say something true about the person who bore it, as Esau says of Jacob (Genesis 27:36).

decisions.choice: set his heart on: take seriously
decisions.reason: To "set the heart" on something is to pay attention to it or be troubled by it (9:20; 2 Samuel 13:33). Abigail asks David not to treat Nabal's insult as worth avenging.

decisions.choice: I did not see: she was not there
decisions.reason: Abigail explains why the messengers got no better answer: she did not see them. Had she known, she implies, she would have received them.

decisions.choice: His name is Nabal, Fool
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the meaning of the name beside it, so that the play on words is not lost.

decisions.choice: His name means 'Fool', and he is a fool!
decisions.reason: Readable explains the name and the play on words in plain words.

decisions.choice: Nabal, « Insensé » (B); Son nom veut dire « Insensé » (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1, r-en-2), Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the name so the play on "folie" is not lost (m1); "insensé" is the word the Psalms and Proverbs note sets for the fool.

decisions.choice: Nabal, que quiere decir Necio
decisions.reason: The name sounds like the Hebrew word for fool (m1), and Abigail plays on it; Balanced and Readable spell it out, as the English does (r-en-1, r-en-2), with “necio”, the word the Proverbs note uses for the fool.

decisions.choice: "Na-banh, nghĩa là 'Kẻ Ngu'"
decisions.reason: The name sounds like the Hebrew word for "fool" (m1); Vietnamese keeps the name and says what it means, as the English Balanced and Readable do.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה אֲדֹנִ֗י חַי־יְהוָ֤ה וְחֵֽי־נַפְשְׁךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מְנָעֲךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ מִבּ֣וֹא בְדָמִ֔ים וְהוֹשֵׁ֥עַ יָדְךָ֖ לָ֑ךְ וְעַתָּ֗ה יִֽהְי֤וּ כְנָבָל֙ אֹיְבֶ֔יךָ וְהַֽמְבַקְשִׁ֥ים אֶל־אֲדֹנִ֖י רָעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, my lord, [by the] life of Yahweh and [by the] life of your soul, that has restrained you Yahweh from coming into bloodshed and saving your hand for you, and now let be like Nabal your enemies and those seeking against my lord evil.

en.L: And now, my lord, [as] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives and [as] your soul lives, since {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has held you back from coming into bloodguilt and from your own hand saving you, now let your enemies and those who seek evil against my lord be like Nabal.
en.B: Now, my lord, as surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives and as surely as you live, it is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who has kept you from shedding blood and from taking revenge with your own hand. So now, may your enemies and all who want to harm my lord be like Nabal.
en.R: My lord, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has kept you from killing people and from taking revenge by yourself. I promise this as surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives and as surely as you live. Now may your enemies, and everyone who wants to hurt you, end up like Nabal.

es.L: Y ahora, señor mío, vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y vive tu alma, ya que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ha impedido venir a [derramar] sangre y que tu propia mano te salve, sean ahora como Nabal tus enemigos y los que buscan el mal contra mi señor.
es.B: Ahora, mi señor, tan cierto como que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vive y que tú vives, es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien te ha impedido derramar sangre y vengarte por tu propia mano. Así que ahora, que tus enemigos y todos los que quieren hacerle daño a mi señor sean como Nabal.
es.R: Mi señor, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ha impedido matar gente y vengarte por tu cuenta. Te lo aseguro, tan cierto como que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vive y que tú vives. Ahora, que tus enemigos, y todos los que quieren hacerte daño, terminen como Nabal.

fr.L: Et maintenant, mon seigneur, [aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant et [que] ton âme est vivante, puisque {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a empêché d’en venir au sang et de te sauver par ta propre main, que maintenant tes ennemis et ceux qui cherchent le mal contre mon seigneur soient comme Nabal.
fr.B: Maintenant, mon seigneur, aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant et que tu es vivant, c’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui t’a empêché de verser le sang et de te venger de ta propre main. Que tes ennemis, et tous ceux qui veulent du mal à mon seigneur, soient donc comme Nabal !
fr.R: Mon seigneur, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a empêché de tuer des gens et de te venger toi-même. Je te le jure, aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant et que tu es vivant. Maintenant, que tes ennemis et tous ceux qui veulent te faire du mal finissent comme Nabal !

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, thưa chúa tôi, thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống và như linh hồn chúa đang sống, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ngăn chúa khỏi mắc tội đổ máu và khỏi tự tay mình báo thù, bây giờ nguyện các kẻ thù của chúa và những kẻ tìm hại chúa tôi đều giống như Na-banh.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, thưa chúa tôi, thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống và như chúa tôi đang sống, chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ngăn chúa tôi khỏi gây đổ máu và khỏi tự tay báo thù. Vậy bây giờ, nguyện các kẻ thù của chúa tôi và mọi kẻ muốn hại chúa tôi đều như Na-banh.
vi.R: Thưa ông, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ngăn ông khỏi giết người và khỏi tự mình báo thù. Tôi xin thề điều này, thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống và như ông đang sống. Bây giờ, nguyện các kẻ thù của ông, và mọi kẻ muốn hại ông, đều sẽ như Na-banh.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh lives and as your soul lives: an oath
decisions.reason: Abigail swears by the life of Yahweh and of David that what she says is true. Jonathan used the same double oath (20:3).

decisions.choice: coming into blood: incurring the guilt of bloodshed
decisions.reason: To "come into blood" is to become guilty of killing. Killing the innocent brought guilt on the killer (Deuteronomy 19:10; verse 31).

decisions.choice: your own hand saving you: taking revenge yourself
decisions.reason: To let one's own hand "save" oneself is to get justice by force instead of leaving it to Yahweh (verses 31, 33; Judges 7:2). David had refused to do this to Saul (24:13).

decisions.choice: Yahweh has held you back: Abigail's coming is God's doing
decisions.reason: Abigail speaks as if it has already happened: by sending her, Yahweh has stopped David. David agrees (verses 32-34).

decisions.choice: may your enemies be like Nabal
decisions.reason: The wish hints at what will happen to Nabal: Yahweh strikes him down (verse 38).

decisions.choice: I promise this as surely as the LORD lives
decisions.reason: Readable states what Yahweh has done first and then gives the oath as a promise that it is true (m1).

source.text: וְעַתָּה֙ הַבְּרָכָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִ֥יא שִׁפְחָתְךָ֖ לַֽאדֹנִ֑י וְנִתְּנָה֙ לַנְּעָרִ֔ים הַמִּֽתְהַלְּכִ֖ים בְּרַגְלֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And now this blessing which has brought your maidservant to my lord, let it be given to the young men who go about at [the] feet of my lord.

en.L: And now this blessing that your maidservant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who walk at the feet of my lord.
en.B: Now let the young men who follow my lord be given this gift that your servant has brought to him.
en.R: I have brought a gift for you, my lord. Please let it be given to the young men who follow you.

es.L: Y ahora, esta bendición que tu sierva ha traído a mi señor, que se dé a los jóvenes que andan a los pies de mi señor.
es.B: Ahora, que este regalo que tu sierva le ha traído a mi señor se dé a los jóvenes que siguen a mi señor.
es.R: Te he traído un regalo, mi señor. Por favor, deja que se lo den a los jóvenes que te siguen.

fr.L: Et maintenant, cette bénédiction que ta servante a apportée à mon seigneur, qu’elle soit donnée aux jeunes gens qui marchent sur les pas de mon seigneur.
fr.B: Que ce présent que ta servante a apporté à mon seigneur soit maintenant donné aux jeunes gens qui suivent mon seigneur.
fr.R: Je t’ai apporté un cadeau, mon seigneur. S’il te plaît, qu’on le donne aux jeunes gens qui te suivent.

vi.L: Bây giờ, món quà phước lành mà tớ gái của chúa đã đem đến cho chúa tôi đây, xin cho các thanh niên đi theo chân chúa tôi.
vi.B: Bây giờ, xin cho các thanh niên theo chúa tôi nhận lấy món quà đầy tớ của chúa tôi đã đem đến đây.
vi.R: Thưa ông, tôi có đem đến một món quà. Xin cho các thanh niên theo ông nhận lấy.

decisions.choice: this blessing: this gift
decisions.reason: A "blessing" can be a gift given with good will (30:26; Genesis 33:11).

decisions.choice: walk at the feet of my lord: follow him
decisions.reason: Those who go "at someone's feet" are his followers or attendants (verse 42; Judges 4:10).

decisions.choice: given to the young men: a gift for David's band
decisions.reason: Abigail modestly offers the food to David's men, the ones Nabal refused (verses 8, 11), rather than to David himself.

decisions.choice: a gift
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plain word (m1).

source.text: שָׂ֥א נָ֖א לְפֶ֣שַׁע אֲמָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֣י עָשֹֽׂה־יַעֲשֶׂה֩ יְהוָ֨ה לַֽאדֹנִ֜י בַּ֣יִת נֶאֱמָ֗ן כִּי־מִלְחֲמ֤וֹת יְהוָה֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י נִלְחָ֔ם וְרָעָ֛ה לֹא־תִמָּצֵ֥א בְךָ֖ מִיָּמֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Forgive please the transgression of your maidservant, for surely will make Yahweh for my lord a house enduring, for [the] battles of Yahweh my lord [is] fighting, and evil not will be found in you from your days.

en.L: Please forgive the transgression of your maidservant, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will certainly make for my lord an enduring house, because my lord is fighting the battles of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and evil will not be found in you all your days.
en.B: Please forgive your servant's offense. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will certainly make my lord a house that lasts, because my lord fights the battles of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and no wrong will be found in you as long as you live.
en.R: Please forgive me for what I have done wrong. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will surely give you a family of kings that will last, because you fight {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s battles. And no one will find any wrong in you as long as you live.

es.L: Perdona, te ruego, la transgresión de tu sierva, porque ciertamente {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará a mi señor una casa duradera, pues mi señor pelea las batallas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y no se hallará mal en ti en todos tus días.
es.B: Por favor, perdona la falta de tu sierva. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sin duda le dará a mi señor una casa firme, porque mi señor pelea las batallas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y no se hallará maldad en ti mientras vivas.
es.R: Por favor, perdóname por lo que hice mal. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sin duda te dará una familia de reyes que durará, porque tú peleas las batallas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Y nadie encontrará maldad en ti mientras vivas.

fr.L: Pardonne, je te prie, la transgression de ta servante, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera certainement à mon seigneur une maison stable, parce que mon seigneur combat les combats {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et le mal ne se trouvera pas en toi de toute ta vie.
fr.B: Pardonne, je te prie, la faute de ta servante. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donnera certainement à mon seigneur une maison qui durera, parce que mon seigneur mène les combats {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et l’on ne trouvera aucun mal en toi tant que tu vivras.
fr.R: S’il te plaît, pardonne-moi le mal que j’ai fait. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donnera sûrement une famille de rois qui durera, parce que tu mènes les combats {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Et personne ne trouvera rien de mal en toi pendant toute ta vie.

vi.L: Xin tha lỗi cho tớ gái của chúa, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chắc chắn sẽ lập cho chúa tôi một nhà vững bền, vì chúa tôi đang đánh những trận chiến của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và trọn đời chúa sẽ không có điều ác nào trong chúa.
vi.B: Xin chúa tôi tha lỗi cho đầy tớ của chúa tôi. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chắc chắn sẽ lập cho chúa tôi một dòng dõi lâu bền, vì chúa tôi đánh những trận chiến của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và suốt đời chúa tôi sẽ không có điều sai trái nào.
vi.R: Xin ông tha lỗi cho tôi. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chắc chắn sẽ cho ông một dòng dõi làm vua lâu dài, vì ông đánh những trận chiến của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Suốt đời ông, sẽ không ai tìm thấy điều sai trái nào nơi ông.

decisions.choice: the transgression of your maidservant: Abigail asks pardon for herself
decisions.reason: She has taken Nabal's guilt on herself (verse 24), and now asks David to forgive it, as well as her boldness in speaking.

decisions.choice: an enduring house: a lasting royal line
decisions.reason: "House" here means a family line. God promised "an enduring house" to a faithful priest (2:35) and later promised David that his house would endure forever (2 Samuel 7:16; 1 Kings 11:38).

decisions.choice: the battles of Yahweh: Israel's wars fought for God
decisions.reason: Saul had sent David to "fight the battles of Yahweh" (18:17). David's wars against Israel's enemies are Yahweh's wars.

decisions.choice: evil will not be found in you: no wrongdoing
alternatives: no disaster will come upon you
decisions.reason: The word can mean wrongdoing or disaster. Here it most likely means that David will do no wrong, which fits Abigail's plea that he not take revenge (verses 26, 31). It could also mean that no harm will come to him.

decisions.choice: a family of kings that will last
decisions.reason: Readable says what the "house" means (m2).

source.text: וַיָּ֤קָם אָדָם֙ לִרְדָפְךָ֔ וּלְבַקֵּ֖שׁ אֶת־נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְֽהָיְתָה֩ נֶ֨פֶשׁ אֲדֹנִ֜י צְרוּרָ֣ה׀בִּצְר֣וֹר הַחַיִּ֗ים אֵ֚ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְאֵ֨ת נֶ֤פֶשׁ אֹיְבֶ֨יךָ֙ יְקַלְּעֶ֔נָּה בְּת֖וֹךְ כַּ֥ף הַקָּֽלַע׃

records.literal_gloss: And has risen a man to pursue you and to seek your life, and will be the life of my lord bound in the bundle of the living with Yahweh your God; and the life of your enemies he will sling out in [the] middle of [the] hollow of the sling.

en.L: And [if] a man rises to pursue you and to seek your life, then the life of my lord will be bound in the bundle of the living with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God; but the life of your enemies {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will sling out from the hollow of the sling.
en.B: If anyone rises up to pursue you and to take your life, the life of my lord will be bound safe in the bundle of the living in the care of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. But the lives of your enemies {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will hurl away as from the pocket of a sling.
en.R: Someone may come after you to kill you. But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will keep your life safe with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, like a treasure tied up in a bag. And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will throw away the lives of your enemies like stones from a sling.

es.L: Y [si] se levanta un hombre para perseguirte y buscar tu vida, la vida de mi señor estará atada en el haz de los vivientes con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios; pero la vida de tus enemigos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la arrojará desde el hueco de la honda.
es.B: Si alguien se levanta para perseguirte y quitarte la vida, la vida de mi señor quedará bien atada en el haz de los vivientes, al cuidado {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios. Pero la vida de tus enemigos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la lanzará lejos, como desde el hueco de una honda.
es.R: Puede ser que alguien te persiga para matarte. Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios guardará tu vida segura junto a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, como un tesoro atado en una bolsa. Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} arrojará lejos la vida de tus enemigos, como piedras lanzadas con una honda.

fr.L: Et [si] un homme se lève pour te poursuivre et pour chercher ta vie, la vie de mon seigneur sera liée dans le sachet des vivants auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu ; mais la vie de tes ennemis, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la lancera du creux de la fronde.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un se lève pour te poursuivre et en veut à ta vie, la vie de mon seigneur sera gardée liée dans le sachet des vivants, sous la protection {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Mais la vie de tes ennemis, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la jettera au loin comme avec une fronde.
fr.R: Quelqu’un te poursuivra peut-être pour te tuer. Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu gardera ta vie en sécurité auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, comme un trésor attaché dans un sac. Et la vie de tes ennemis, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la jettera au loin comme les pierres d’une fronde.

vi.L: [Nếu] có người nổi lên đuổi theo chúa và tìm hại mạng sống chúa, thì mạng sống của chúa tôi sẽ được gói trong bọc của những người sống nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của chúa; còn mạng sống của các kẻ thù chúa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ném đi như từ trong lòng cái ná.
vi.B: Nếu có ai nổi lên đuổi theo chúa tôi để lấy mạng chúa tôi, thì mạng sống của chúa tôi sẽ được gói giữ an toàn trong bọc của những người sống, dưới sự chăm sóc của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của chúa tôi. Còn mạng sống của các kẻ thù, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ném đi như ném đá từ túi của cái ná.
vi.R: Có thể sẽ có người đuổi theo để giết ông. Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của ông, sẽ giữ mạng sống ông an toàn bên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như một báu vật được gói kỹ trong túi. Còn mạng sống của các kẻ thù ông, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ném đi như ném đá bằng ná.

decisions.choice: bound in the bundle of the living: kept safe by Yahweh
alternatives: listed in the record of the living
decisions.reason: A bundle was a pouch in which something precious was tied up and kept, such as money (Genesis 42:35; Proverbs 7:20). David's life will be held safe, like a treasure, in Yahweh's keeping. Some take the bundle as a list or record of those who are to live, like the book of Exodus 32:32. The phrase speaks of David being kept alive; later Jewish readers used it of life with God after death.

decisions.choice: if a man rises: a condition
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets out a case: should anyone rise up against David, then what follows is sure. The pursuer is not named, but Saul is in view (23:15; 24:15).

decisions.choice: sling out from the hollow of the sling
decisions.reason: As David slung a stone at Goliath (17:40, 49), Yahweh will fling David's enemies away. The sling's pocket held the stone before it was let fly.

decisions.choice: with Yahweh: in Yahweh's keeping
decisions.reason: "With" means near him and under his care.

decisions.choice: bound safe; in the care of
decisions.reason: Balanced adds what the picture implies (m1, m4).

decisions.choice: like a treasure tied up in a bag
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the bundle (m1) instead of reproducing it.

decisions.choice: atada en el haz de los vivientes
alternatives: guardada en la bolsa de la vida
decisions.reason: A bundle in which valuables were tied up for safekeeping: David's life kept safe by the LORD (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the picture; Readable explains it, as the English does (r-en-2).

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לַֽאדֹנִ֔י כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אֶת־הַטּוֹבָ֖ה עָלֶ֑יךָ וְצִוְּךָ֥ לְנָגִ֖יד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be when will do Yahweh for my lord according to all that he has spoken, the good concerning you, and has appointed you as ruler over Israel,

en.L: And it will be, when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} does for my lord according to all the good that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has spoken concerning you, and appoints you ruler over Israel,
en.B: When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has done for my lord every good thing {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has promised you, and has made you ruler over Israel,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will do for you all the good things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has promised, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will make you the leader of Israel.

es.L: Y sucederá que, cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haga a mi señor conforme a todo el bien que ha hablado acerca de ti, y te ponga por gobernante sobre Israel,
es.B: Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le haya hecho a mi señor todo el bien que te ha prometido, y te haya hecho gobernante de Israel,
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará por ti todas las cosas buenas que te ha prometido, y te hará líder de Israel.

fr.L: Et il arrivera, quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera pour mon seigneur selon tout le bien qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit à ton sujet, et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’établira chef sur Israël,
fr.B: Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aura fait pour mon seigneur tout le bien qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a promis et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’aura établi chef d’Israël,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera pour toi tout le bien qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a promis, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera de toi le chef d’Israël.

vi.L: Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho chúa tôi mọi điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về chúa, và lập chúa làm người lãnh đạo trên Y-sơ-ra-ên,
vi.B: Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho chúa tôi mọi điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với chúa tôi, và đã lập chúa tôi làm người lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên,
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ làm cho ông mọi điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ lập ông làm người lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên.

decisions.choice: ruler: the one Yahweh appoints to lead
decisions.reason: The word names the leader whom Yahweh chooses for his people (9:16; 10:1; 13:14). Saul's own words show that David will hold this place (24:21).

decisions.choice: all the good he has spoken concerning you
decisions.reason: Abigail speaks of a promise already known: Samuel had anointed David (16:13), and Jonathan and Saul had both said he would be king (23:17; 24:21).

decisions.choice: the sentence goes on into verse 31
decisions.reason: Verse 30 states the time ("when Yahweh has done ..."), and verse 31 what follows. It is one sentence across two verses.

decisions.choice: ends with a comma
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the sentence running into verse 31.

decisions.choice: two sentences
decisions.reason: Readable makes verse 30 a statement of its own and starts verse 31 with "When that happens".

decisions.choice: chef
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for *nagid*: "chef" at every level, the leader whom the LORD appoints (m1).

decisions.choice: gobernante (L, B); líder (R)
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note's wording for *nagid*, the one the LORD appoints to lead (m1). Recorded once for this block.

decisions.choice: "người lãnh đạo" for *nagid*
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for *nagid* at every level in Vietnamese.

source.text: וְלֹ֣א תִהְיֶ֣ה זֹ֣את׀לְךָ֡ לְפוּקָה֩ וּלְמִכְשׁ֨וֹל לֵ֜ב לַאדֹנִ֗י וְלִשְׁפָּךְ־דָּם֙ חִנָּ֔ם וּלְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֲדֹנִ֖י ל֑וֹ וְהֵיטִ֤ב יְהוָה֙ לַֽאדֹנִ֔י וְזָכַרְתָּ֖ אֶת־אֲמָתֶֽךָ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: and not will be this to you for staggering and for stumbling of heart for my lord, and to pour out blood without cause and for my lord saving himself. And will do good Yahweh to my lord, and you will remember your maidservant.

en.L: this will not be to you a staggering or a stumbling of heart for my lord, either to have poured out blood without cause or for my lord to have saved himself. And when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} does good to my lord, then remember your maidservant."
en.B: my lord will not have this on his mind, no troubled conscience for having shed blood without cause or for having taken revenge himself. And when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has dealt well with my lord, remember your servant."
en.R: When that happens, you will not feel sorry or guilty for having killed people for no reason, or for having taken revenge yourself. And when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has been good to you, please remember me."

es.L: esto no será para ti tropiezo ni remordimiento de corazón para mi señor, el haber derramado sangre sin causa o el haberse salvado mi señor por sí mismo. Y cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haga bien a mi señor, acuérdate de tu sierva».
es.B: mi señor no tendrá esto sobre la conciencia, ni el remordimiento de haber derramado sangre sin motivo o de haberse vengado por sí mismo. Y cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le haya hecho bien a mi señor, acuérdate de tu sierva».
es.R: Cuando eso pase, no tendrás que sentirte mal ni culpable por haber matado gente sin motivo, ni por haberte vengado tú mismo. Y cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haya sido bueno contigo, por favor, acuérdate de mí».

fr.L: ceci ne sera pas pour toi un trébuchement ni une chute du cœur, pour mon seigneur, d’avoir versé le sang sans raison ou de s’être sauvé lui-même. Et quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera du bien à mon seigneur, souviens-toi de ta servante. »
fr.B: mon seigneur n’aura pas ce poids sur le cœur, ni le remords d’avoir versé le sang sans raison ou de s’être vengé lui-même. Et quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aura comblé mon seigneur de bienfaits, souviens-toi de ta servante. »
fr.R: Quand cela arrivera, tu n’auras pas de regret ni de remords d’avoir tué des gens sans raison, ou de t’être vengé toi-même. Et quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’aura fait du bien, s’il te plaît, souviens-toi de moi. »

vi.L: thì điều này sẽ không trở thành sự vấp váp hay sự day dứt trong lòng chúa tôi, vì đã đổ máu vô cớ, hay vì chúa tôi đã tự mình báo thù. Và khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm ơn cho chúa tôi, xin hãy nhớ đến tớ gái của chúa."
vi.B: thì chúa tôi sẽ không phải bận lòng, không bị lương tâm cắn rứt vì đã đổ máu vô cớ hay vì đã tự tay báo thù. Và khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban ơn cho chúa tôi, xin hãy nhớ đến đầy tớ của chúa tôi."
vi.R: Khi điều ấy xảy ra, ông sẽ không phải hối tiếc hay áy náy vì đã giết người vô cớ, hay vì đã tự mình báo thù. Và khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban ơn cho ông, xin ông nhớ đến tôi."

decisions.choice: a staggering or a stumbling of heart: regret and a troubled conscience
decisions.reason: Both words picture tripping or reeling. A "stumbling of heart" is the inner trouble that comes from guilt, like David's later "heart striking him" (24:6; 2 Samuel 24:10).

decisions.choice: pouring out blood without cause: killing the innocent
decisions.reason: "Without cause" means without just reason. To kill Nabal's household would make David guilty of innocent blood (19:5).

decisions.choice: remember your maidservant
decisions.reason: Abigail asks David to show her favor once he is king, as Joseph asked Pharaoh's cupbearer (Genesis 40:14). In the end David marries her (verse 42).

decisions.choice: feel sorry or guilty
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the pictures (m1).

decisions.choice: your servant (Balanced); me (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 24.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר דָּוִ֖ד לַאֲבִיגַ֑ל בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר שְׁלָחֵ֛ךְ הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה לִקְרָאתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And said David to Abigail, Blessed [be] Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sent you this day to meet me.

en.L: And David said to Abigail, "Blessed [be] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, who sent you this day to meet me.
en.B: David answered Abigail, "Blessed be {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, who has sent you out to meet me today.
en.R: David said to Abigail, "Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel! He sent you to meet me today.

es.L: Y dijo David a Abigail: «Bendito [sea] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, que te envió hoy a mi encuentro.
es.B: David le respondió a Abigail: «Bendito sea {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, que te ha enviado hoy a mi encuentro.
es.R: David le dijo a Abigail: «¡Alabado sea {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel! Él te envió hoy a mi encuentro.

fr.L: Et David dit à Abigaïl : « Béni [soit] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, qui t’a envoyée aujourd’hui à ma rencontre !
fr.B: David répondit à Abigaïl : « Béni soit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, qui t’a envoyée aujourd’hui à ma rencontre !
fr.R: David a dit à Abigaïl : « Louange {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël ! C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui t’a envoyée à ma rencontre aujourd’hui.

vi.L: Đa-vít nói với A-bi-ga-in: "Đáng chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, Đấng đã sai bà đến gặp tôi ngày hôm nay.
vi.B: Đa-vít đáp với A-bi-ga-in: "Đáng chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, Đấng đã sai bà ra gặp tôi hôm nay.
vi.R: Đa-vít nói với A-bi-ga-in: "Ngợi khen {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên! {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã sai bà đến gặp tôi hôm nay.

decisions.choice: blessed be Yahweh: praise and thanks to God
decisions.reason: To "bless" God is to praise and thank him for what he has done.

decisions.choice: who sent you: David sees God's hand in her coming
decisions.reason: David agrees with Abigail (verse 26): it was Yahweh who sent her to stop him.

decisions.choice: Praise
decisions.reason: Readable uses "praise", the plain sense of blessing God (m1).

decisions.choice: David says "bà" to Abigail and "tôi" for himself
decisions.reason: A grown woman of standing who has come to him with courtesy; David answers in kind.

source.text: וּבָר֥וּךְ טַעְמֵ֖ךְ וּבְרוּכָ֣ה אָ֑תְּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר כְּלִתִ֜נִי הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ מִבּ֣וֹא בְדָמִ֔ים וְהֹשֵׁ֥עַ יָדִ֖י לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And blessed [be] your discernment, and blessed [be] you, who have restrained me this day from coming into bloodshed and saving my hand for me.

en.L: And blessed [be] your discernment, and blessed [be] you, who have kept me this day from coming into bloodguilt and from my own hand saving me.
en.B: Blessed be your good judgment, and blessed be you, for keeping me today from shedding blood and from taking revenge with my own hand.
en.R: Your good sense is a blessing, and may you be blessed! Today you have kept me from killing people and from taking revenge myself.

es.L: Y bendito [sea] tu buen juicio, y bendita [seas] tú, que me has impedido hoy venir a [derramar] sangre y que mi propia mano me salvara.
es.B: Bendito sea tu buen juicio, y bendita seas tú, por haberme impedido hoy derramar sangre y vengarme por mi propia mano.
es.R: Tu buen juicio es una bendición, ¡y que Dios te bendiga! Hoy me has impedido matar gente y vengarme por mi cuenta.

fr.L: Et béni [soit] ton discernement, et bénie [sois]-tu, toi qui m’as retenu aujourd’hui d’en venir au sang et de me sauver par ma propre main.
fr.B: Béni soit ton bon sens, et bénie sois-tu, toi qui m’as empêché aujourd’hui de verser le sang et de me venger de ma propre main.
fr.R: Ton bon sens est une bénédiction, et que Dieu te bénisse ! Aujourd’hui, tu m’as empêché de tuer des gens et de me venger moi-même.

vi.L: Đáng chúc phước cho sự khôn ngoan của bà, và đáng chúc phước cho bà, là người đã ngăn tôi hôm nay khỏi mắc tội đổ máu và khỏi tự tay mình báo thù.
vi.B: Phước cho sự sáng suốt của bà, và phước cho bà, vì hôm nay bà đã ngăn tôi khỏi gây đổ máu và khỏi tự tay báo thù.
vi.R: Sự khôn ngoan của bà là một phước lành, và nguyện bà được phước! Hôm nay bà đã ngăn tôi khỏi giết người và khỏi tự mình báo thù.

decisions.choice: your discernment: your good judgment
decisions.reason: The word means taste, and so discernment or good sense (Psalm 119:66). David praises the wisdom the narrator noted at the start (verse 3).

decisions.choice: kept me from coming into bloodguilt: Abigail's own words
decisions.reason: David repeats what Abigail said Yahweh had done (verse 26), now saying it of her: God has worked through her.

decisions.choice: Your good sense is a blessing, and may you be blessed!
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the two blessings in plain words.

source.text: וְאוּלָ֗ם חַי־יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר מְנָעַ֔נִי מֵהָרַ֖ע אֹתָ֑ךְ כִּ֣י׀לוּלֵ֣י מִהַ֗רְתְּ וַתָּבֹאת֙ לִקְרָאתִ֔י כִּ֣י אִם־נוֹתַ֧ר לְנָבָ֛ל עַד־א֥וֹר הַבֹּ֖קֶר מַשְׁתִּ֥ין בְּקִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And however, [by the] life of Yahweh, the God of Israel, who has held me back from harming you, for if not you had hurried and come to meet me, surely not would have been left to Nabal until [the] light of the morning one urinating against a wall.

en.L: But truly, [as] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, lives, who has held me back from harming you, if you had not hurried and come to meet me, surely there would not have been left to Nabal by the light of morning [even] one who urinates against a wall."
en.B: But as surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, lives, who held me back from doing you harm, if you had not hurried out to meet me, not a single male belonging to Nabal would have been left alive by daybreak."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, has kept me from hurting you. As surely as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives, if you had not hurried to meet me, not one man or boy in Nabal's household would have been alive by morning."

es.L: Pero ciertamente, vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, que me ha impedido hacerte daño, que si no te hubieras apresurado a venir a mi encuentro, no le habría quedado a Nabal para la luz de la mañana [siquiera] uno que orine contra la pared».
es.B: Pero tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, que me impidió hacerte daño, si no te hubieras apresurado a salir a mi encuentro, al amanecer no le habría quedado con vida a Nabal ni un solo varón».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, me ha impedido hacerte daño. Tan cierto como que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vive, si no te hubieras apresurado a venir a mi encuentro, para la mañana no habría quedado vivo ni un solo hombre o niño de la casa de Nabal».

fr.L: Mais vraiment, [aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, est vivant, lui qui m’a retenu de te faire du mal, si tu ne t’étais pas hâtée de venir à ma rencontre, il ne serait resté à Nabal, à la lumière du matin, [pas même] un seul qui urine contre le mur. »
fr.B: Mais aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, est vivant, lui qui m’a empêché de te faire du mal, si tu ne t’étais pas hâtée de venir à ma rencontre, il ne serait pas resté à Nabal un seul mâle vivant au lever du jour. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, m’a empêché de te faire du mal. Aussi vrai qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est vivant, si tu ne t’étais pas dépêchée de venir à ma rencontre, il ne serait pas resté demain matin un seul homme ni un seul garçon vivant dans la maison de Nabal. »

vi.L: Nhưng thật, thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, hằng sống, là Đấng đã ngăn tôi làm hại bà, nếu bà không vội vàng đến gặp tôi, thì chắc chắn đến sáng mai Na-banh sẽ không còn sót lại một đứa đái vào tường."
vi.B: Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, hằng sống, là Đấng đã ngăn tôi làm hại bà, nếu bà không vội ra gặp tôi, thì đến sáng mai Na-banh sẽ không còn một người nam nào sống sót."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, đã ngăn tôi làm hại bà. Thật như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hằng sống, nếu bà không vội đến gặp tôi, thì đến sáng mai trong nhà Na-banh sẽ không còn một người đàn ông hay bé trai nào sống sót."

decisions.choice: harming you: Abigail too was in danger
decisions.reason: David would have harmed Abigail as well, since she belonged to Nabal's household. Yahweh's restraint saved her too.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh lives: an oath
decisions.reason: David swears to the truth of what he says, as Abigail did (verse 26).

decisions.choice: and you had come: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) have an unusual spelling of this verb; the form marked to be read aloud (qere) is the ordinary "and you came". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: one who urinates against a wall: a male
decisions.reason: As in verse 22.

decisions.choice: a single male (Balanced); one man or boy (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 22.

decisions.choice: the LORD ... has kept me; As surely as he lives
decisions.reason: Readable states what Yahweh has done first and then gives the oath.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֤ח דָּוִד֙ מִיָּדָ֔הּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִ֖יאָה ל֑וֹ וְלָ֣הּ אָמַ֗ר עֲלִ֤י לְשָׁלוֹם֙ לְבֵיתֵ֔ךְ רְאִי֙ שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי בְקוֹלֵ֔ךְ וָאֶשָּׂ֖א פָּנָֽיִךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And took David from her hand what she had brought to him, and to her he said, Go up in peace to your house; see, I have listened to your voice and have lifted your face.

en.L: And David took from her hand what she had brought him, and to her he said, "Go up in peace to your house. See, I have listened to your voice and lifted up your face."
en.B: Then David accepted what she had brought him from her hand, and told her, "Go back home in peace. I have listened to what you said, and I grant your request."
en.R: Then David accepted the gifts she had brought him. He told her, "Go home and do not worry. I have listened to you, and I will do what you asked."

es.L: Y tomó David de su mano lo que le había traído, y a ella le dijo: «Sube en paz a tu casa. Mira, he escuchado tu voz y he alzado tu rostro».
es.B: Entonces David recibió de su mano lo que ella le había traído, y le dijo: «Vuelve a tu casa en paz. He escuchado lo que dijiste y te concedo lo que pides».
es.R: Entonces David aceptó los regalos que ella le había traído. Le dijo: «Vete a tu casa y no te preocupes. Te he escuchado, y haré lo que me pediste».

fr.L: Et David prit de sa main ce qu’elle lui avait apporté, et il lui dit : « Monte en paix à ta maison. Vois, j’ai écouté ta voix et j’ai relevé ton visage. »
fr.B: Puis David accepta de sa main ce qu’elle lui avait apporté et lui dit : « Remonte chez toi en paix. J’ai écouté ce que tu m’as dit, et j’accède à ta demande. »
fr.R: Ensuite, David a accepté les cadeaux qu’elle lui avait apportés. Il lui a dit : « Rentre chez toi, ne t’inquiète pas. Je t’ai écoutée, et je ferai ce que tu m’as demandé. »

vi.L: Đa-vít nhận từ tay bà những gì bà đã đem đến cho ông, và nói với bà: "Hãy đi lên nhà bà bình an. Kìa, tôi đã nghe tiếng bà và nâng mặt bà lên."
vi.B: Rồi Đa-vít nhận từ tay bà những gì bà đã đem đến, và nói với bà: "Hãy về nhà bình an. Tôi đã nghe lời bà và chấp nhận điều bà xin."
vi.R: Rồi Đa-vít nhận những món quà bà đã đem đến. Ông nói với bà: "Bà hãy về nhà và đừng lo. Tôi đã nghe bà, và tôi sẽ làm như bà xin."

decisions.choice: lifted up your face: granted your request
decisions.reason: To "lift someone's face" is to receive a person with favor and grant what is asked (Genesis 19:21; 32:21).

decisions.choice: took from her hand: accepted the gift
decisions.reason: Accepting a gift was a sign of peace between two parties (Genesis 33:10-11). David's anger is over.

decisions.choice: go up in peace: go home safe
decisions.reason: A farewell that also promises that no harm will come to her or her household.

decisions.choice: Go home and do not worry; I will do what you asked
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the farewell and of the idiom (m1, m3).

source.text: וַתָּבֹ֣א אֲבִיגַ֣יִל׀אֶל־נָבָ֡ל וְהִנֵּה־לוֹ֩ מִשְׁתֶּ֨ה בְּבֵית֜וֹ כְּמִשְׁתֵּ֣ה הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְלֵ֤ב נָבָל֙ ט֣וֹב עָלָ֔יו וְה֥וּא שִׁכֹּ֖ר עַד־מְאֹ֑ד וְלֹֽא־הִגִּ֣ידָה לּ֗וֹ דָּבָ֥ר קָטֹ֛ן וְגָד֖וֹל עַד־א֥וֹר הַבֹּֽקֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: And came Abigail to Nabal, and look, to him [was] a feast in his house like [the] feast of the king, and [the] heart of Nabal [was] good upon him, and he [was] drunk to very [much]; and not she told him a thing small or great until [the] light of the morning.

en.L: And Abigail came to Nabal, and look, he [was holding] a feast in his house like the feast of a king, and the heart of Nabal [was] merry within him, and he [was] very drunk. So she did not tell him anything, small or great, until the light of morning.
en.B: When Abigail came back to Nabal, he was holding a feast in his house, a feast fit for a king. Nabal was in high spirits and very drunk, so she told him nothing at all until daybreak.
en.R: When Abigail came home, Nabal was having a big party at his house, like a party for a king. He was happy and very drunk. So she did not tell him anything until the next morning.

es.L: Y llegó Abigail a Nabal, y he aquí que él [tenía] un banquete en su casa como banquete de rey, y el corazón de Nabal [estaba] alegre dentro de él, y [estaba] muy borracho. Y no le contó nada, ni poco ni mucho, hasta la luz de la mañana.
es.B: Cuando Abigail volvió a donde estaba Nabal, él estaba celebrando en su casa un banquete digno de un rey. Nabal estaba muy alegre y completamente borracho, así que ella no le dijo absolutamente nada hasta el amanecer.
es.R: Cuando Abigail llegó a su casa, Nabal estaba dando una gran fiesta, como la fiesta de un rey. Estaba contento y muy borracho. Así que ella no le contó nada hasta la mañana siguiente.

fr.L: Et Abigaïl arriva chez Nabal, et voici, il [donnait] dans sa maison un festin comme un festin de roi, et le cœur de Nabal [était] joyeux en lui, et il [était] ivre au plus haut point. Et elle ne lui dit rien, ni petite ni grande chose, jusqu’à la lumière du matin.
fr.B: Quand Abigaïl rentra auprès de Nabal, il donnait dans sa maison un festin digne d’un roi. Nabal était de joyeuse humeur et complètement ivre ; aussi ne lui dit-elle absolument rien avant le lever du jour.
fr.R: Quand Abigaïl est rentrée, Nabal faisait une grande fête chez lui, comme une fête de roi. Il était joyeux et complètement ivre. Alors elle ne lui a rien dit jusqu’au lendemain matin.

vi.L: A-bi-ga-in đến với Na-banh, và kìa, ông đang [mở] một bữa tiệc trong nhà mình như bữa tiệc của vua. Lòng Na-banh vui vẻ, và ông say khướt. Vì vậy bà không nói gì với ông, dù nhỏ hay lớn, cho đến khi trời sáng.
vi.B: Khi A-bi-ga-in trở về với Na-banh, ông đang mở tiệc trong nhà, một bữa tiệc như tiệc của vua. Na-banh đang vui vẻ và say khướt, nên bà không nói gì với ông cho đến sáng.
vi.R: Khi A-bi-ga-in về đến nhà, Na-banh đang mở một bữa tiệc lớn trong nhà, như tiệc của vua. Ông đang vui vẻ và say khướt. Vì vậy bà không nói gì với ông cho đến sáng hôm sau.

decisions.choice: a feast like the feast of a king: Nabal lives like a king
decisions.reason: The shearing feast (verse 2) is lavish. The story contrasts Nabal, who feasts like a king, with David, the future king, to whom he refused bread (verse 11). Absalom's shearing feast in 2 Samuel 13:23-28 is also a scene of drunkenness.

decisions.choice: the heart of Nabal was good: he was merry with wine
decisions.reason: A "good heart" here means high spirits from drinking (Judges 16:25; 2 Samuel 13:28; Esther 1:10).

decisions.choice: small or great: nothing at all
decisions.reason: The pair means nothing of any kind (20:2; 22:15).

decisions.choice: a feast fit for a king
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the sense of the comparison.

source.text: וַיְהִ֣י בַבֹּ֗קֶר בְּצֵ֤את הַיַּ֨יִן֙ מִנָּבָ֔ל וַתַּגֶּד־ל֣וֹ אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיָּ֤מָת לִבּוֹ֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ וְה֖וּא הָיָ֥ה לְאָֽבֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was in the morning, when went out the wine from Nabal, and told him his wife these things, and died his heart within him, and he became stone.

en.L: And it happened in the morning, when the wine had gone out of Nabal, that his wife told him these things; and his heart died within him, and he became a stone.
en.B: In the morning, when Nabal was sober, his wife told him all this. His heart failed him, and he became like a stone.
en.R: The next morning, when Nabal was sober again, his wife told him what had happened. His heart failed him, and he lay there like a stone.

es.L: Y sucedió por la mañana, cuando a Nabal se le había ido el vino, que su mujer le contó estas cosas; y su corazón murió dentro de él, y se quedó como una piedra.
es.B: Por la mañana, cuando a Nabal ya se le había pasado la borrachera, su esposa le contó todo esto. El corazón le falló, y se quedó como una piedra.
es.R: A la mañana siguiente, cuando a Nabal ya se le había pasado la borrachera, su esposa le contó lo que había pasado. El corazón le falló, y se quedó tendido como una piedra.

fr.L: Et il arriva, au matin, quand le vin fut sorti de Nabal, que sa femme lui raconta ces choses ; et son cœur mourut en lui, et il devint [comme] une pierre.
fr.B: Le matin, quand Nabal fut dégrisé, sa femme lui raconta tout cela. Son cœur s’arrêta presque, et il devint comme une pierre.
fr.R: Le lendemain matin, quand Nabal n’était plus ivre, sa femme lui a raconté ce qui s’était passé. Il a eu une attaque, et il est resté couché là, immobile comme une pierre.

vi.L: Buổi sáng, khi Na-banh đã hết say rượu, vợ ông kể cho ông những việc ấy; lòng ông chết lịm trong mình, và ông trở nên như đá.
vi.B: Sáng hôm sau, khi Na-banh đã tỉnh rượu, vợ ông kể cho ông mọi chuyện. Tim ông như ngừng đập, và ông trở nên như hòn đá.
vi.R: Sáng hôm sau, khi Na-banh đã tỉnh rượu, vợ ông kể lại cho ông những gì đã xảy ra. Tim ông như ngừng đập, và ông nằm cứng đờ như hòn đá.

decisions.choice: when the wine had gone out of Nabal: when he was sober
decisions.reason: The picture is of the wine leaving him as he slept it off (compare 1:14).

decisions.choice: his heart died within him, and he became a stone: a sudden collapse
decisions.reason: Hearing how close he had come to death, Nabal collapsed and could not move. It may describe a stroke or a failure of the heart, which left him helpless until he died ten days later (verse 38); the text does not say exactly what happened. The heart was also the seat of courage, so the words may also say that his spirit was crushed.

decisions.choice: His heart failed him; like a stone
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use a common phrase for the heart's failing and make the comparison plain.

source.text: וַיְהִ֖י כַּעֲשֶׂ֣רֶת הַיָּמִ֑ים וַיִּגֹּ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־נָבָ֖ל וַיָּמֹֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was about ten days, and struck Yahweh Nabal, and he died.

en.L: And it happened after about ten days that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} struck Nabal, and he died.
en.B: About ten days later {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} struck Nabal, and he died.
en.R: About ten days later, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} struck Nabal down, and he died.

es.L: Y sucedió que, como diez días después, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hirió a Nabal, y murió.
es.B: Unos diez días después, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hirió a Nabal, y este murió.
es.R: Unos diez días más tarde, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hirió a Nabal, y murió.

fr.L: Et il arriva, environ dix jours après, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappa Nabal, et il mourut.
fr.B: Environ dix jours plus tard, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappa Nabal, et il mourut.
fr.R: Environ dix jours plus tard, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a frappé Nabal, et il est mort.

vi.L: Khoảng mười ngày sau, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đánh Na-banh, và ông chết.
vi.B: Khoảng mười ngày sau, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đánh Na-banh, và ông chết.
vi.R: Khoảng mười ngày sau, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đánh phạt Na-banh, và ông chết.

decisions.choice: Yahweh struck Nabal: his death is God's judgment
decisions.reason: The narrator says that Yahweh himself struck Nabal. What Abigail asked David to leave to Yahweh (verses 26, 31), Yahweh has done. David says the same about Saul later (26:10).

decisions.choice: about ten days: the time after Nabal's collapse
decisions.reason: The ten days are counted from the morning when Nabal heard the news (verse 37).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע דָּוִד֮ כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת נָבָל֒ וַיֹּ֡אמֶר בָּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֡ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָב֩ אֶת־רִ֨יב חֶרְפָּתִ֜י מִיַּ֣ד נָבָ֗ל וְאֶת־עַבְדּוֹ֙ חָשַׂ֣ךְ מֵֽרָעָ֔ה וְאֵת֙ רָעַ֣ת נָבָ֔ל הֵשִׁ֥יב יְהוָ֖ה בְּרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח דָּוִד֙ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר בַּאֲבִיגַ֔יִל לְקַחְתָּ֥הּ ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And heard David that had died Nabal, and said, Blessed [be] Yahweh, who has pleaded [the] case of my reproach from [the] hand of Nabal, and his servant he has kept back from evil, and the evil of Nabal has returned Yahweh on his head. And sent David and spoke to Abigail to take her for himself as wife.

en.L: And David heard that Nabal had died, and he said, "Blessed [be] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who has pleaded the case of my insult from the hand of Nabal, and has kept back {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} slave from evil; and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has returned the evil of Nabal on his [own] head." And David sent and spoke to Abigail, to take her for himself as a wife.
en.B: When David heard that Nabal had died, he said, "Blessed be {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who has taken up my case against Nabal for the insult he gave me, and has kept {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant from doing evil. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has brought Nabal's evil back on his own head." Then David sent word to Abigail, asking her to become his wife.
en.R: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, "Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Nabal insulted me, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has judged him for it. He kept me, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant, from doing wrong, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has punished Nabal for the evil he did." Then David sent messengers to Abigail to ask her to marry him.

es.L: Y oyó David que Nabal había muerto, y dijo: «Bendito [sea] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que ha defendido la causa de mi afrenta de mano de Nabal, y ha detenido a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo del mal; y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho volver la maldad de Nabal sobre su [propia] cabeza». Y envió David a hablar con Abigail, para tomarla por esposa.
es.B: Cuando David supo que Nabal había muerto, dijo: «Bendito sea {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que ha defendido mi causa contra Nabal por la afrenta que me hizo, y ha impedido que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo hiciera el mal. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho caer la maldad de Nabal sobre su propia cabeza». Luego David mandó a decirle a Abigail que quería tomarla por esposa.
es.R: Cuando David supo que Nabal había muerto, dijo: «¡Alabado sea {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Nabal me insultó, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo ha juzgado por eso. Me impidió a mí, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo, hacer el mal, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha castigado a Nabal por el mal que hizo». Luego David envió mensajeros a Abigail para pedirle que se casara con él.

fr.L: Et David apprit que Nabal était mort, et il dit : « Béni [soit] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui a défendu la cause de mon outrage [en la reprenant] de la main de Nabal, et qui a retenu {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur de faire le mal ; et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait retomber la méchanceté de Nabal sur sa [propre] tête. » Et David envoya parler à Abigaïl, pour la prendre pour femme.
fr.B: Quand David apprit que Nabal était mort, il dit : « Béni soit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui a pris en main ma cause contre Nabal pour l’outrage qu’il m’avait fait, et qui a empêché {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur de faire le mal. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait retomber la méchanceté de Nabal sur sa propre tête. » Puis David envoya demander à Abigaïl de devenir sa femme.
fr.R: Quand David a appris que Nabal était mort, il a dit : « Louange {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! Nabal m’avait insulté, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a jugé pour cela. Il m’a empêché, moi, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, de mal agir, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a puni Nabal pour le mal qu’il avait fait. » Ensuite, David a envoyé des messagers à Abigaïl pour lui demander de l’épouser.

vi.L: Đa-vít nghe Na-banh đã chết thì nói: "Đáng chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã bênh vực tôi trong vụ sỉ nhục từ tay Na-banh, và đã giữ đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi làm điều ác; {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đổ điều ác của Na-banh lại trên đầu nó." Rồi Đa-vít sai người đến nói với A-bi-ga-in, để cưới bà làm vợ.
vi.B: Khi Đa-vít nghe tin Na-banh đã chết, ông nói: "Đáng chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã bênh vực tôi trước sự sỉ nhục của Na-banh, và đã giữ đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi làm điều ác. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đổ lại điều ác của Na-banh trên đầu nó." Rồi Đa-vít sai người đến hỏi A-bi-ga-in làm vợ.
vi.R: Khi Đa-vít nghe tin Na-banh đã chết, ông nói: "Ngợi khen {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Na-banh đã sỉ nhục tôi, nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xét xử nó vì điều đó. {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giữ tôi, là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, khỏi làm điều sai trái, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phạt Na-banh vì điều ác nó đã làm." Rồi Đa-vít sai người đến hỏi A-bi-ga-in làm vợ.

decisions.choice: pleaded the case of my insult: took up my cause
decisions.reason: To "plead someone's case" is to act as his advocate and judge, as David had asked Yahweh to do against Saul (24:16). Yahweh has defended David's honor against Nabal's insult.

decisions.choice: returned the evil of Nabal on his own head
decisions.reason: Wrongdoing comes back on the one who did it (Judges 9:57; 1 Kings 2:44). Nabal's punishment fits what he did.

decisions.choice: kept his servant from evil: from taking revenge
decisions.reason: David sees that Yahweh kept him from doing wrong, through Abigail (verses 32-34).

decisions.choice: spoke to Abigail to take her as a wife: a proposal of marriage
decisions.reason: David sent messengers to ask for her hand (verse 40). As a widow, Abigail could give her own answer.

decisions.choice: his slave
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "slave", as with "my servant David" elsewhere; Balanced and Readable have "servant".

decisions.choice: Nabal insulted me, but the LORD has judged him for it
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long blessing into short sentences and states the insult first.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur at every level
decisions.reason: The English Literal keeps "slave" (r-en-1); the Samuel and Psalms terms notes set "serviteur" at every level in French for a named servant of God, David included.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo
decisions.reason: The English Literal says “slave” here (r-en-1); Spanish follows the Psalms note, which keeps “siervo” at every level for a named servant of God, David included.

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ Ngài" at Literal too
decisions.reason: The English Literal says "slave", but the Psalms terms note keeps "servant" at every level in Vietnamese for a named servant of God.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ עַבְדֵ֥י דָוִ֛ד אֶל־אֲבִיגַ֖יִל הַכַּרְמֶ֑לָה וַיְדַבְּר֤וּ אֵלֶ֨יהָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר דָּוִד֙ שְׁלָחָ֣נוּ אֵלַ֔יִךְ לְקַחְתֵּ֥ךְ ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And came [the] servants of David to Abigail to Carmel, and spoke to her saying, David has sent us to you to take you to him as wife.

en.L: And the servants of David came to Abigail at Carmel, and they spoke to her, saying, "David has sent us to you to take you to him as a wife."
en.B: David's servants came to Abigail at Carmel and said to her, "David has sent us to you to take you to be his wife."
en.R: David's servants went to Abigail at Carmel. They told her, "David sent us to bring you to him to be his wife."

es.L: Y vinieron los siervos de David a Abigail, a Carmel, y le hablaron, diciendo: «David nos ha enviado a ti para tomarte por esposa».
es.B: Los siervos de David fueron a ver a Abigail a Carmel y le dijeron: «David nos ha enviado a buscarte para que seas su esposa».
es.R: Los siervos de David fueron a ver a Abigail a Carmel. Le dijeron: «David nos envió para llevarte con él, para que seas su esposa».

fr.L: Et les serviteurs de David vinrent chez Abigaïl à Carmel, et ils lui parlèrent, en disant : « David nous a envoyés vers toi pour te prendre pour sa femme. »
fr.B: Les serviteurs de David arrivèrent chez Abigaïl à Carmel et lui dirent : « David nous a envoyés vers toi pour te prendre comme épouse. »
fr.R: Les serviteurs de David sont allés chez Abigaïl, à Carmel. Ils lui ont dit : « David nous a envoyés pour t’amener à lui, pour que tu deviennes sa femme. »

vi.L: Các đầy tớ của Đa-vít đến với A-bi-ga-in tại Cạt-mên và nói với bà: "Đa-vít đã sai chúng tôi đến với bà để đưa bà về làm vợ ông."
vi.B: Các đầy tớ của Đa-vít đến gặp A-bi-ga-in tại Cạt-mên và thưa với bà: "Đa-vít sai chúng tôi đến đón bà về làm vợ ông."
vi.R: Các đầy tớ của Đa-vít đến gặp A-bi-ga-in tại Cạt-mên. Họ nói với bà: "Đa-vít sai chúng tôi đến đưa bà về làm vợ ông."

decisions.choice: at Carmel: Abigail is still at Nabal's estate
decisions.reason: Nabal's flocks and property were at Carmel (verse 2), and Abigail was there.

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: David's envoys are "servants" at every level, as in verse 10.

source.text: וַתָּ֕קָם וַתִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ אַפַּ֖יִם אָ֑רְצָה וַתֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֤ה אֲמָֽתְךָ֙ לְשִׁפְחָ֔ה לִרְחֹ֕ץ רַגְלֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And she arose and bowed down [with] face to [the] ground and said, Look, your maidservant [is] as a slave-girl to wash [the] feet of [the] servants of my lord.

en.L: And she arose and bowed down [with her] face to the ground, and said, "Look, your maidservant [is] a slave girl to wash the feet of the servants of my lord."
en.B: She got up and bowed down with her face to the ground, and said, "Your servant is ready to be a maid who washes the feet of my lord's servants."
en.R: Abigail got up and bowed down with her face to the ground. She said, "I am ready to serve. I would even wash the feet of my lord's servants."

es.L: Y ella se levantó, y se inclinó rostro a tierra, y dijo: «He aquí que tu sierva [es] una esclava para lavar los pies de los siervos de mi señor».
es.B: Ella se levantó, se inclinó rostro en tierra y dijo: «Tu sierva está dispuesta a ser una criada que lave los pies de los siervos de mi señor».
es.R: Abigail se levantó y se inclinó con el rostro en tierra. Dijo: «Estoy dispuesta a servir. Hasta lavaría los pies de los siervos de mi señor».

fr.L: Et elle se leva et se prosterna le visage contre terre, et elle dit : « Voici, ta servante [est] une esclave pour laver les pieds des serviteurs de mon seigneur. »
fr.B: Elle se leva, se prosterna le visage contre terre et dit : « Ta servante est prête à être une domestique qui lave les pieds des serviteurs de mon seigneur. »
fr.R: Abigaïl s’est levée et elle s’est inclinée, le visage contre le sol. Elle a dit : « Je suis prête à servir. Je laverais même les pieds des serviteurs de mon seigneur. »

vi.L: Bà đứng dậy, sấp mặt xuống đất lạy và nói: "Kìa, tớ gái của chúa là một nữ tì để rửa chân cho các đầy tớ của chúa tôi."
vi.B: Bà đứng dậy, cúi mặt sát đất và nói: "Đầy tớ của chúa tôi sẵn sàng làm nữ tì để rửa chân cho các đầy tớ của chúa tôi."
vi.R: A-bi-ga-in đứng dậy, cúi mặt sát đất. Bà nói: "Tôi sẵn sàng phục vụ. Tôi xin được rửa chân cho các đầy tớ của ông."

decisions.choice: slave girl: the lowest of servants
decisions.reason: Abigail calls herself first a maidservant and then a slave girl, a still humbler word (1:18). Washing the feet of guests was the work of the lowest servant.

decisions.choice: look, your maidservant is a slave girl: she accepts
decisions.reason: The words are a humble way of saying yes. Abigail accepts David's offer and puts herself at his service, even to his servants.

decisions.choice: a maid (Balanced); serve (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use "servant" and "maid"; Literal keeps "slave girl" for the humbler word.

source.text: וַתְּמַהֵ֞ר וַתָּ֣קָם אֲבִיגַ֗יִל וַתִּרְכַּב֙ עַֽל־הַחֲמ֔וֹר וְחָמֵשׁ֙ נַעֲרֹתֶ֔יהָ הַהֹלְכ֖וֹת לְרַגְלָ֑הּ וַתֵּ֗לֶךְ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ מַלְאֲכֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד וַתְּהִי־ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And hurried and arose Abigail and rode on the donkey, and five her maids who went at her feet; and she went after [the] messengers of David and became to him as wife.

en.L: And Abigail hurried and arose and rode on the donkey, with five of her maids who walked at her feet; and she went after the messengers of David and became his wife.
en.B: Abigail quickly got up and mounted her donkey, with her five maids attending her. She followed David's messengers and became his wife.
en.R: Abigail quickly got ready and rode off on her donkey, with her five servant girls walking with her. She went with David's messengers and became David's wife.

es.L: Y se apresuró Abigail y se levantó, y montó en el asno, con cinco de sus doncellas que iban a sus pies; y fue tras los mensajeros de David, y llegó a ser su esposa.
es.B: Abigail se levantó enseguida y montó en su asno, acompañada de sus cinco doncellas. Siguió a los mensajeros de David y llegó a ser su esposa.
es.R: Abigail se preparó rápido y se fue montada en su burro, con cinco criadas que caminaban con ella. Se fue con los mensajeros de David y llegó a ser la esposa de David.

fr.L: Et Abigaïl se hâta et se leva, et elle monta sur l’âne, avec cinq de ses jeunes filles qui marchaient sur ses pas ; et elle suivit les messagers de David et devint sa femme.
fr.B: Abigaïl se leva aussitôt et monta sur son âne, accompagnée de ses cinq servantes. Elle suivit les messagers de David et devint sa femme.
fr.R: Abigaïl s’est vite préparée et elle est partie sur son âne, avec ses cinq servantes qui marchaient à côté d’elle. Elle est partie avec les messagers de David et elle est devenue la femme de David.

vi.L: A-bi-ga-in vội vàng đứng dậy, cưỡi lừa, có năm tớ gái đi theo chân bà; bà đi theo các sứ giả của Đa-vít và trở thành vợ ông.
vi.B: A-bi-ga-in vội vàng đứng dậy, cưỡi lừa, có năm tớ gái theo hầu. Bà đi theo các sứ giả của Đa-vít và trở thành vợ ông.
vi.R: A-bi-ga-in vội vàng chuẩn bị rồi cưỡi lừa ra đi, có năm cô đầy tớ gái đi theo. Bà đi với các sứ giả của Đa-vít và trở thành vợ Đa-vít.

decisions.choice: who walked at her feet: who attended her
decisions.reason: As in verse 27, those "at someone's feet" are attendants.

decisions.choice: five maids: a woman of standing
decisions.reason: Abigail comes with her own attendants, as a wealthy woman would.

decisions.choice: servant girls
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plain word for her maids.

source.text: וְאֶת־אֲחִינֹ֛עַם לָקַ֥ח דָּוִ֖ד מִֽיִּזְרְעֶ֑אל וַתִּהְיֶ֛יןָ גַּֽם־שְׁתֵּיהֶ֥ן ל֖וֹ לְנָשִֽׁים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And Ahinoam David had taken from Jezreel, and they became also both of them to him as wives.

en.L: And David had taken Ahinoam from Jezreel, and the two of them also became his wives.
en.B: David had also married Ahinoam of Jezreel, so both of them became his wives.
en.R: David had already married Ahinoam from the town of Jezreel. So both women became his wives.

es.L: Y David había tomado a Ahinoam de Jezreel, y ambas también llegaron a ser sus esposas.
es.B: David también se había casado con Ahinoam de Jezreel, así que las dos llegaron a ser sus esposas.
es.R: David ya se había casado con Ahinoam, del pueblo de Jezreel. Así que las dos mujeres llegaron a ser sus esposas.

fr.L: Et David avait pris Ahinoam de Jizreël, et elles devinrent toutes deux ses femmes.
fr.B: David avait aussi épousé Ahinoam de Jizreël, et toutes deux devinrent ses femmes.
fr.R: David avait déjà épousé Ahinoam, de la ville de Jizreël. Ainsi, les deux femmes sont devenues ses épouses.

vi.L: Đa-vít cũng đã cưới A-hi-nô-am người Gít-rê-ên, và cả hai đều trở thành vợ ông.
vi.B: Đa-vít cũng đã cưới A-hi-nô-am người Gít-rê-ên, nên cả hai đều là vợ ông.
vi.R: Trước đó Đa-vít đã cưới A-hi-nô-am ở thành Gít-rê-ên. Vậy cả hai bà đều là vợ ông.

decisions.choice: Jezreel: a town in the hill country of Judah
decisions.reason: This Jezreel is the town near Maon and Carmel (Joshua 15:55-56), not the better-known Jezreel in the north (29:1).

decisions.choice: had taken: before he married Abigail
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts Ahinoam first and uses a form that looks back. Ahinoam is named first in later lists too (27:3; 2 Samuel 3:2). Saul's wife had the same name (14:50), but the text does not connect them.

decisions.choice: married
decisions.reason: "Take" a woman means to marry her.

decisions.choice: "A-hi-nô-am người Gít-rê-ên"
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "A-hi-nô-am"; "Gít-rê-ên" for Jezreel is the usual Protestant form, kept the same through both books.

source.text: וְשָׁא֗וּל נָתַ֛ן אֶת־מִיכַ֥ל בִּתּ֖וֹ אֵ֣שֶׁת דָּוִ֑ד לְפַלְטִ֥י בֶן־לַ֖יִשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִגַּלִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And Saul had given Michal his daughter, [the] wife of David, to Palti son of Laish, who [was] from Gallim.

en.L: And Saul had given Michal his daughter, David's wife, to Palti son of Laish, who [was] from Gallim.
en.B: Saul, for his part, had given David's wife Michal, his own daughter, to Palti son of Laish, who was from Gallim.
en.R: But Saul had taken his daughter Michal, who was David's wife, and given her to another man, Palti son of Laish, from the town of Gallim.

es.L: Y Saúl había dado a Mical su hija, mujer de David, a Palti hijo de Lais, que [era] de Galim.
es.B: Saúl, por su parte, había dado a Mical, su propia hija y esposa de David, a Palti hijo de Lais, que era de Galim.
es.R: Pero Saúl le había quitado a David su esposa Mical, la hija de Saúl, y se la había dado a otro hombre, Palti hijo de Lais, del pueblo de Galim.

fr.L: Et Saül avait donné sa fille Mikal, la femme de David, à Palti, fils de Laïsh, qui [était] de Gallim.
fr.B: Saül, de son côté, avait donné Mikal, sa fille, la femme de David, à Palti, fils de Laïsh, de Gallim.
fr.R: Mais Saül avait repris à David sa fille Mikal, qui était la femme de David, et il l’avait donnée à un autre homme, Palti, fils de Laïsh, de la ville de Gallim.

vi.L: Sau-lơ đã gả con gái mình là Mi-canh, vợ Đa-vít, cho Pha-ti con trai La-ích, người ở Ga-lim.
vi.B: Còn Sau-lơ thì đã gả con gái mình là Mi-canh, vợ Đa-vít, cho Pha-ti con trai La-ích, người ở Ga-lim.
vi.R: Nhưng Sau-lơ đã bắt con gái mình là Mi-canh, vợ của Đa-vít, gả cho một người khác là Pha-ti con trai La-ích, ở thành Ga-lim.

decisions.choice: Michal, David's wife: married to another man
decisions.reason: Michal had married David (18:27) and helped him escape (19:11-17). While David was a fugitive, Saul gave her to another man. David later took her back (2 Samuel 3:13-16), where her second husband is called Paltiel.

decisions.choice: Gallim: a village of Benjamin
decisions.reason: Gallim lay near Saul's town Gibeah, north of Jerusalem (Isaiah 10:30).

decisions.choice: had given: before this point in the story
decisions.reason: The verb looks back. By giving David's wife to another man, Saul cut David's tie to the royal house.

decisions.choice: had taken ... and given her to another man
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain that Michal was taken from David.

decisions.choice: Palti, Laïsh, Gallim; Jizreël (verse 43)
decisions.reason: Names not in the terms table, in the usual French transcription, kept the same through both books.

decisions.choice: Palti hijo de Lais, de Galim
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish forms of these names (m2); Palti's longer name Paltiel at 2 Samuel 3:15 is the Hebrew's own variation.
